findings.message: 8 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "A Bible that reads like paper" above "Be still, and read."; "Chapter One" above "Easier on your eyes than any glowing scr"; "Chapter Two" above "The only Bible app with no advertisement"; "Chapter Three" above "Simplicity is beauty."; "Chapter Four" above "The Word in every tongue."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 32 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "A Bible that reads like paper", "Chapter One", "Every other app", "Watchers Bible").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 33 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.badge → rgba(22, 23, 20, 0.12) 0px 8px 20px 0px, rgba(22, 23, 20, 0.06) 0px 2px 5px 0px | a.badge → rgba(22, 23, 20, 0.12) 0px 8px 20px 0px, rgba(22, 23, 20, 0.06) 0px 2px 5px 0px | div#heroPhone.phone.phone-hero → rgba(22, 23, 20, 0.22) 0px 18px 44px 0px, rgba(22, 23, 20, 0.1) 0px 4px 10px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: 9 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.topbar 1440px | div.cmp.cmp-lcd 525px | section#adfree.chapter.chapter-tint 1440px | section#tongues.chapter.chapter-tint 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (6 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 194px on the left, 231px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "still," (screen 1, 100% hidden); "and" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "read." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Easier" (screen 2, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
